title: AI trade is leading the stock market again: Chart of the Day
title_zh: 人工智能交易再次引领股市：每日图表
summary: Tech stocks just notched their ninth straight day of gains. The stock market leadership behind that run looks a lot like the trade that powered the last bull market.
summary_zh: 科技股刚刚连续第九天上涨。这次上涨背后的股市领导力看起来很像推动上一次牛市的交易。

title: Morning Brief: Goldman rakes it in, but issues a warning
title_zh: 早间简报：高盛大赚一笔，但发出警告
summary: Despite a Hormuz blockade, an outlook warning from Goldman Sachs, and oil still surfing the $100 per barrel, the stock market resumed its progress up and to the right.
summary_zh: 尽管霍尔木兹海峡封锁、高盛发出前景警告，且油价仍在每桶 100 美元上方徘徊，但股市仍恢复了向上和向右的走势。

title: Amazon Nears Deal for Globalstar in Push to Rival Musk’s Starlink
title_zh: 亚马逊接近达成 Globalstar 交易，向竞争对手马斯克的 Starlink 发起冲击
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Amazon.com Inc. is in advanced talks to acquire satellite operator Globalstar Inc.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——亚马逊公司正在就收购卫星运营商 Globalstar Inc. 进行深入谈判。

title: OpenAI's $852 billion valuation faces investor scrutiny amid strategy shift, FT reports
title_zh: 据英国《金融时报》报道，OpenAI 8520 亿美元的估值因战略转变而面临投资者审查
summary: OpenAI's $852 billion valuation is under scrutiny from some of its own backers as the company ‌shifts its focus to the enterprise market to fend ‌off competition from Anthropic, the Financial Times reported on Tuesday.
summary_zh: 据英国《金融时报》周二报道，OpenAI 8520 亿美元的估值正受到其一些支持者的密切关注，因为该公司将重点转向企业市场以抵御来自 Anthropic 的竞争。

title: Amazon nears deal to buy Globalstar, Bloomberg News reports
title_zh: 据彭博社报道，亚马逊即将达成收购 Globalstar 的交易
summary: Amazon is in ‌advanced talks ‌to acquire satellite ​telecom group Globalstar, a deal that would bolster ‌the ⁠tech major's push to build ⁠its own satellite operation, ​Bloomberg ​News ​reported on ‌Monday.
summary_zh: 据彭博新闻周一报道，亚马逊正在就收购卫星电信集团 Globalstar 进行高级谈判，这笔交易将支持这家科技巨头建立自己的卫星运营业务。

title: What US-Iran escalations mean for multiples, earnings season
title_zh: 美国和伊朗的升级对市盈率和财报季意味着什么
summary: US stocks (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) are holding onto gains ahead of Monday's session close after President Trump's blockade of the Strait of Hormuz went into effect today. This comes after failed ceasefire negotiations between US and Iranian officials over the weekend.
summary_zh: 在特朗普总统今天对霍尔木兹海峡的封锁生效后，美国股市（^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC）在周一收盘前保持上涨。此前，美国和伊朗官员周末停火谈判失败。

title: Amazon stock leads 9-day Mag 7 performance, Tesla falls behind
title_zh: 亚马逊股票 9 天 Mag 7 表现领先，特斯拉落后
summary: Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre takes a look at megacaps' recent stock performance, including Big Tech names like Amazon (AMZN), Broadcom (AVGO), and Tesla (TSLA).
summary_zh: 雅虎金融市场和数据编辑贾里德·布利克 (Jared Blikre) 审视了大型科技公司近期的股票表现，其中包括亚马逊 (AMZN)、博通 (AVGO) 和特斯拉 (TSLA) 等大型科技公司。

title: Amazon stock is leading the 'Magnificent 7' rebound — but the rally is hitting a ceiling: Chart of the Day
title_zh: 亚马逊股票引领“华丽七”反弹，但反弹已触及上限：每日图表
summary: Amazon stock has been one of the strongest names in the "Magnificent Seven" since the broader market's March 30 low. But after a sharp three-day surge, its rally is now running into an area that has repeatedly stopped it before.
summary_zh: 自大盘 3 月 30 日触及低点以来​​，亚马逊股票一直是“七巨头”中表现最强劲的股票之一。但在经历了三天的大幅上涨之后，其涨势现在正在进入之前曾多次阻止的区域。
